about.title: About
about.sub: A bilingual personal library of books, ideas, and mental models.
about.p1: This site is not a display of what I have read. It is a personal navigation system for knowledge: using classic books as entry points to understand AI, technology, finance, investment, economics, history, society, business, and ideas.
about.p2: It rests on three simple judgments. First, read fewer bad books and more classics. Second, follow underlying patterns rather than news cycles. Third, use one book to understand a field and a set of classics to build a cognitive map.
about.p3: All Chinese and English content is written separately, not machine translated. Bibliographic details are verified, and every summary is original.
about.how_body: Book → Idea → Topic → Article → Knowledge Map → Personal World Model. You can enter at any layer, or follow it through.

principles.title: Classics first
principles.body: Only books that explain underlying patterns and remain worth rereading a decade later. Popularity is not a reason to include a book.

principles.title: Bilingual by design
principles.body: Chinese and English are two independent content fields, each written naturally, consistent in meaning but not word-for-word.

principles.title: Built to last
principles.body: Content is plain text and structured data. It depends on no commercial platform and can be migrated, backed up, and republished at any time.

about.stack_body: Statically generated, with no runtime dependencies. The site uses files as its database and renders every page at build time, which makes it fast, durable, and easy to move.
about.contact_body: Rayman works in semiconductor materials, invests in US equities, and follows AI, materials science, and cognitive methods closely. This library is his personal reading and thinking system.
